argv: set -e; R=$HOME/.local/share/bridge-comand-bootstrap; git -C "$R" fetch origin main; git -C "$R" checkout --detach origin/main; ONE_WAVE_PROJECT_ROOT=/home/Scales/One-Wave-Science bash "$R/hive-pipe/bootstrap_chatgpt_terminal_pull.sh"; systemctl --user is-active one-wave-live-machine-executor.service; systemctl --user is-enabled one-wave-live-machine-executor.service; systemctl --user is-active one-wave-bootstrap.timer; printf 'SELF_HEAL_LOOP_OK\n'
